properties.name: org.codeblessing.alpstein.exampledata.createRandomData
properties.description: Whether random example data is created and persisted on startup of Spring Boot.

properties.name: org.codeblessing.alpstein.exampledata.createRandomData.forGeneratedItems
properties.description: Create random example data for the generated items having a primary key in addition to the manually implemented items.

properties.name: org.codeblessing.alpstein.persistence.type
properties.description: Repository implementation to use: 'in-memory' (default) or 'postgres'. With 'postgres' the PostgresSql*Repository beans take precedence over the InMemory*Repository ones.
